name: Bio Pen Q2 EMS microneedling pen
shortDescription: Cordless, premium EMS microneedling device with LED light therapy: microneedling, EMS electroporation and blue/red LED in a single device.
description: The Bio Pen Q2 combines microneedling, EMS electroporation microcurrent and blue/red LED light therapy in a single cordless device. It activates skin regeneration, boosts collagen production and delivers active ingredients deeper – for face, eye-area, scalp and body treatments. You can work with 7 pre-designed treatment programs, from glass skin to superficial scars.

videoDescription.headline: Bio Pen Q2 – complex skin renewal in a single device
paragraphs: The Bio Pen Q2 combines microneedling, EMS electroporation microcurrent and LED light therapy. Sterile microneedles create microscopic channels in the skin that trigger natural regeneration: collagen and elastin production increases, and skin firmness, texture and tone improve.

EMS electroporation temporarily increases the permeability of cell membranes, so active ingredients – hyaluronic acid, peptides, vitamin complexes, growth factors – penetrate much deeper. The 25-pole pulsed EMS system creates a dense, even microcurrent field between the needles, reducing irritation and increasing effectiveness.

Dual LED light therapy further boosts the results: 470 nm blue light soothes irritated, acne-prone skin and regulates sebum production, while 630 nm red light supports collagen synthesis and regeneration and softens fine lines.

Cordless design, Smart Touch display, automatic induction holder (placed on the stand it pauses, lifted off it resumes at the same speed) and adjustable 0–1.5 mm needle depth – comfortable, hygienic and precise work on the face, eye area, scalp, neck, décolleté and body.

faq.question: What is microneedling?
faq.answer: Sterile microneedles create controlled, microscopic channels in the skin, which trigger natural regeneration: collagen and elastin production increases, and skin firmness, texture and tone improve. The Bio Pen Q2 complements this with EMS electroporation and LED therapy.

faq.question: What does EMS electroporation mean?
faq.answer: EMS microcurrent temporarily increases the permeability of cell membranes, so active ingredients (hyaluronic acid, peptides, vitamin complexes, growth factors) are absorbed deeper and more effectively.

faq.question: Which cartridge heads are available?
faq.answer: 9-needle (eye area, finer wrinkles, localized scars), 14-needle (hair treatment, scalp stimulation), 25-needle (full face, neck, décolleté, body) and the needle-free nano head (sensitive treatments, hydration, active-ingredient delivery). The cartridges are sterile, single-use units.

faq.question: Which areas can it be used on?
faq.answer: Face (anti-aging, wrinkle reduction, pore tightening, fading pigment spots), eye area, hair-bearing scalp (supporting thinning hair), neck and décolleté, as well as body treatments (stretch marks, firming lax skin).

faq.question: Does the Bio Pen Q2 come with training?
faq.answer: Yes, the price includes basic device-operator training. If you wish, you can also request optional 1:1 training with a live model at our showroom in Érd.

faq.question: What treatment programs does the device have?
faq.answer: 7 pre-designed treatment programs support your work, from glass skin treatment to the treatment of superficial scars. Needle depth is adjustable between 0–1.5 mm, EMS can be set to 3 levels, and the handpiece features red and blue LED.

faq.question: When is the treatment not recommended?
faq.answer: In cases of active inflammation, infection, bleeding disorders, rosacea flare-ups, pregnancy, autoimmune diseases and certain medications. The cartridge is new for every client and cannot be re-sterilized; disinfecting the device before and after treatment is recommended.
